title: Maamkuzi na Maagano (Theme 1: Uzalendo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child asks three questions before greeting: who is it, what time is it, am I arriving or leaving; then says the greeting and waits for its reply.

floor.prerequisite: Says his own name and a friend's name.
floor.question: Unaitwa nani?

representations: a chart of greetings with their replies side by side
picture cards: babu, rafiki, mwalimu, darasa
a sun chart for the time of day
steps: Think of the time of day.
Say the greeting, then listen for the reply.
contexts: arriving at school in the morning

board.do: Point at the picture of babu.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child greets a friend and then an elder, each with its own reply.

misconceptions.ask: "Hujambo?" ni swali. Jibu lake ni lipi?
misconceptions.repair: Ukiulizwa "Hujambo?" unajibu "Sijambo," maana yake sina tatizo.

misconceptions.ask: Unayemsalimu ni mzee au mtoto mwenzako?
misconceptions.repair: Mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu!

misconceptions.ask: Ni nani mdogo katika salamu hii, na anasema nini?
misconceptions.repair: Mtoto anasema Shikamoo; mzee anajibu Marahaba.

misconceptions.ask: Ni wakati gani wa siku sasa?
misconceptions.repair: Salamu hufuata wakati: Habari za asubuhi mwalimu!

misconceptions.ask: Mwalimu alimsalimu mtu mmoja au darasa zima?
